name: HUD chip
summary: A persistent pill (live dot, a value like a score, separator, uppercase meta) that wipes open from the left and keeps context on screen across scenes. Exposes `value` as a shared-element flight target (see scoreboard-flip flyTo).

params.pace: { enter, exit, stagger, accent } overrides for the PACE timings (seconds)

changelog: v2 2026-09-26: readable pacing. Transitions use PACE (entrances about 0.5 s, exits about 0.4 s, staggers about 0.14 s) with a `pace` override, cues.out means fully gone, and default cues and the demo leave time to read.
